name: 44700-mixedbatch-35b-2gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, bfloat16, 14 shards, 71.9 GB. A substitution -- see `fidelity`.
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3, NVLink, bare metal -- two cards of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism. One in-process vLLM engine (guidellm `vllm_python`): no router, no external cache tier, no KV connector.
architecture: hybrid multimodal MoE decoder, Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration: 40 text layers, 256 experts with 8 active per token plus a shared expert (~3B active of ~35B), and a 27-layer vision tower that is not loaded here. All of it reads off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, bounded at 1024 requests with a 3600 s safety cap. The declared 10% warmup and 10% cooldown each resolve to a phase that excludes nothing, so all 1024 requests are scored; read the count off `request_latency.successful.count` rather than deriving it.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, text only: exactly 8192 prompt tokens and exactly 256 output tokens, min == max on both, greedy (`temperature 0.0`), ignore_eos, prefix caching off so every request is a full prefill, seed 44700 static. The chat template and its specials add a handful of tokens, so the wire prompt reads slightly above 8192.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant on a 35-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model, serving 256 concurrent eight-thousand-token requests across two GPUs.
launch:
# The engine command line for this setup.
model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-35B-A3B
tensor-parallel-size: 2
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 256
max-model-len: 16384
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: false
language-model-only: true
gdn-prefill-backend: triton
